questions.q: Which of these is a required step before closing a Payables period?
options: Resolving or deliberately carrying forward outstanding holds
Deleting all invoices entered during the period
Switching every supplier's payment method to EFT
Cancelling all open purchase orders
questions.explain: Outstanding holds need to be resolved or consciously carried forward before a period can close cleanly.

questions.q: Why might Oracle Fusion Payables refuse to let a period close?
options: Because too many suppliers are set up
Because there are unaccounted transactions or unresolved holds dated in that period
Because the chart of accounts has too many segments
Because the ledger currency is not USD
questions.explain: Payables blocks closing a period that still has unaccounted transactions or unresolved holds, since those numbers could still change.

questions.q: What does the Payables-to-Ledger Reconciliation report compare?
options: This month's invoices against last month's invoices
Two different suppliers' payment histories
The AP liability balance in the subledger against the AP liability balance in the General Ledger
Matching tolerances across business units
questions.explain: This report ties the ending AP liability per Payables to the ending AP liability per the General Ledger.

questions.q: In the Solace Robotics example, the reconciliation report shows a $0 difference. What does that indicate?
options: The period cannot close because of the discrepancy
All invoices are still on hold
No invoices were processed that month
The subledger and the ledger agree, supporting a clean period close
questions.explain: A zero difference means the subledger and GL are in agreement, which is what a clean close requires.

questions.q: If the Payables-to-Ledger Reconciliation report showed a non-zero difference, what would that most likely point to?
options: A pricing error on a single invoice
Something accounted in Payables but not yet transferred, or transferred but not yet posted in GL
An incorrect matching tolerance
A missing supplier bank account
questions.explain: A mismatch typically traces back to the accounted/transferred/posted pipeline from Lesson 38 -- a step that didn't complete on one side.
